title: Great concept, poor execution
text: Great concept, poor execution. My mixer came with this shield, and it was one of the deciding factors between the Artisan and the Design model, as I thought it would be very helpful.  On the first time using my mixer, I got this set in place (noting that it doesn't grip the bowl in any way, but barely perches on the edge), and turned on the mixer to the lowest speed.  The vibration on the lowest speed was enough to knock the shield around, and I had to put one hand on the shield to actually pour anything through it.  I've now used the mixer several times without the shield and find it much easier to just leave this off.  If it secured to the bowl, it might be a different story.  As it is, I put it on when I'm NOT using the mixer to keep dust out, but even then, it's not great coverage, so it will likely get stuck in a cabinet in the future.
